points.name: sports.list_edit.flag_icon
points.interpretation: The row builder selects sport_flag.bin or sport_unflag.bin for each item.

points.name: sports.list_edit.delete_icon
points.interpretation: The row builder selects sport_del.bin or sport_undel.bin for each item according to the list count.

points.name: sports.list_edit.gradient_icon
points.interpretation: The edit view sets sports/list/gradient.bin after building its rows.

points.name: sports.countdown.initial_icon
points.interpretation: The countdown page formats the initial realtime/1.bin path and passes it to the image setter.

points.name: sports.countdown.animation_icon
points.interpretation: The animation callback updates the image source with realtime/1.bin through realtime/3.bin according to elapsed time.

edit_create_analysis: The descriptor points to Thumb 0xc58f66d. The bytes at 0xc58f660..0xc58f66b are a literal pool; IDA treats part as instructions. The actual entry at 0xc58f66c begins with PUSH.W and saves R1 as the root.
category_scope: The two category descriptors invoke the shared list builder with different descriptor-private allocations. Only their lifecycle slots are named here.
countdown_scope: Initial and animation image setter calls only; the animation ready callback starts a sport and is not altered.
limitations: Changing countdown display can misrepresent progress; skipping lifecycle calls can break timers and starting a workout. Source lifetime matters. State and descriptor slots are not thread barriers; device behavior and recovery are unverified.
